goal: Comply with BIP 144 by ignoring MSG_WITNESS_TX announcements on wtxidrelay connections
Reliably disconnect peers that announce transactions on connections where transaction relay is disabled
agreement: Concept approval following up on a previous review discussion (l0rinc)
Resolved objection: breaking wild Neutrino nodes addressed by retaining non-wtxidrelay support (0xB10C)
Resolved objection: breaking unmaintained peers in the wild addressed by author update (darosior)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it ensures nodes properly disconnect peers violating tx-relay rules on restricted links
Enforces BIP 144 compliance with minimal risk to existing network clients
